data.summary: I checked the figures against what I know of Apple's fiscal 2025 results, and they are correct: revenue of $416.2B (up from $391.0B in fiscal 2024), net income of $112.0B, operating income of $133.1B, total assets of $359.2B, and cash and cash equivalents of $35.9B. I didn't check the revenue growth percentage, because the user's note said it had already been verified.
